arguments.sql:
SELECT f."School Name" AS name,
       CONCAT_WS(', ', s.street, s.city, s.state, s.zip) AS address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" ILIKE '%High%'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

arguments.sql:
SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name,
       (f."FRPM Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)",0)) AS frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.soc = '66'
  AND f."Low Grade" IN ('1','K')
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

```sql
WITH magnet_k8 AS (
    SELECT s.cdscode, s.city
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.magnet = 1
      AND s.gsserved = 'K-8'
),
multiple_provision AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM magnet_k8 mk
    JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = mk.cdscode
    WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
city_counts AS (
    SELECT s.city, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.gsserved = 'K-8'
    GROUP BY s.city
)
SELECT 'Multiple_Provision_Schools' AS description, cnt::text AS value
FROM multiple_provision
UNION ALL
SELECT city AS description, cnt::text AS value
FROM city_counts
ORDER BY description;
```

final_sql:

```sql
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM player_attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM player_attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) ld
    ON pa.player_api_id = ld.player_api_id
   AND pa.date = ld.max_date
)
SELECT ((a.overall_rating - p.overall_rating)::numeric / p.overall_rating) * 100 AS percentage_higher
FROM (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM latest
    WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM player WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk')
) a,
(
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM latest
    WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
) p;
```

```sql
WITH older_patients AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.sex
    FROM patient AS p
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.birthday)) > 55
),
abnormal_pt AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.sex
    FROM older_patients AS o
    JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = o.id

)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS female_percentage
FROM abnormal_pt;
```
